2️⃣ Physical Catastrophe: 90%-CO ESP Blast, 34°C P4 Fire & PH3 Detonation
• -800 Pa negative draft sucks air into 90% CO + P4 gas inside the 60 kV electrostatic precipitator!
• Draining water seal exposes 60°C molten white phosphorus to air → 0.1s autoignition (34°C AIT!)
